title: SoulFactory sidecar relay support

observed_behavior.symptom: Browser logs incomplete EOSE warnings because the Bahia sidecar closes REQ filters for SoulFactory kinds 31950, 31951, 31952, and 30317 as not readable.

intended_behavior.summary: SoulFactory is direct Nostr interop, not Bahia legacy control-plane traffic. The sidecar relay accepts valid signed SoulFactory lifecycle events and allows browser-safe REQ filters for SoulFactory templates, souls, drafts, capabilities, requests, progress, and results.

out_of_scope: Replacing SoulFactory with ContextVM or REST
Relaxing Bahia legacy custom kind fail-closed migration policy
